newsitem.title: USA: View Tech names O'Brien chairman.
newsitem.headline: View Tech names O'Brien chairman.

text.p: View Tech Inc Thursday named Paul O'Brien, former chairman and chief executive officer of New England Telephone, to the post of chairman.
He succeeds Robert Hatfield, who remains View Tech chief executive officer. O'Brien also joins the View Tech board.
In a statement, View Tech said Telecom Holding LLC, an investment company organized by O'Brien, had agreed to invest in View Tech.
Telecom will invest in newly issued View Tech shares on or before January 30, subject to certain conditions, it said.
View Tech intends to use proceeds from the transaction for working capital and payment of certain costs associated with its recent merger with USTeleCenters Inc.
New England Telephone is a unit of NYNEX Corp.
